source.note: 35 runs and 5 lifts (4 chairlifts + 1 magic carpet) per Indy Pass page; 100 acres per OnTheSnow, which lists 30 trails. Lift types (2026-09-30 search summary): 3 quad chairs, 1 double chair and 1 surface lift; the Indy page calls the fifth lift a magic carpet, stored as other.

source.note: 97% snowmaking per OnTheSnow; lodging per swain.com/lodging and the Indy Pass listing.

character: Independent, family-oriented ski area in the hills of Allegany County in western New York, with about 650 ft (198 m) of vertical, four chairlifts plus a carpet and near-complete snowmaking coverage. It has its own lodging and has been an Indy Pass partner since the 2020-21 season.
learning: Research found only partial beginner information: the lift roster includes one magic carpet, and the Indy Pass listing mentions children's programs. Lesson program names and the beginner-area layout were not found.

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-28. OnTheSnow (third party) projects an opening of 2026-12-19 and a closing of 2027-03-28; these are projections, not announcements (https://www.onthesnow.com/new-york/swain/ski-resort). No historical opening dates were found.
